column1: # title: Table 450.5(A) Maximum Rating or Setting of Overcurrent Protection for Transformers Over 1000 Volts (as a Percentage of Transformer-Rated Current)
# note: ¹Where the required fuse rating or circuit breaker setting does not correspond to a standard rating or setting
column2: a higher rating or setting that does not exceed one ofthe following shall be permitted:

column1: # note: (1) The next higher standard rating or setting for fuses and circuit breakers in accordance with 240.6 for1000 volts and below
# note: (2) The next higher commercially available rating or setting for fuses and circuit breakers above 1000 volts
# note: ²Where secondary overcurrent protection is required
column2: the secondary OCPD shall be permitted to consist of not more than six circuit breakers or six sets of fuses grouped in one location. Where multiple OCPDs are utilized
column3: the total of all the device ratings shall not exceed the allowed value of a single OCPD. If both circuit breakers and fuses are used as the OCPD
column4: the total of the OCPD ratings shall not exceed that allowed for fuses.

column1: # note: ³A supervised location is a location where conditions of maintenance and supervision ensure that only qualified persons monitor and service the transformer installation.
# note: ⁴Electronically actuated fuses that can be set to open at a specific current shall be set in accordance with settings for circuit breakers.
# note: ⁵A transformer equipped with a coordinated thermal overload protection by the manufacturer shall be permitted to have separate secondary protection omitted.
